## 🔗 Related Issue

Addresses #2854

## 📝 Summary

This PR fixes one of the bugs identified in #2854 related to `gRPC` service registration

```sh
# Terminal 1, boot the server
MCPGATEWAY_UI_ENABLED=true MCPGATEWAY_ADMIN_API_ENABLED=true MCPGATEWAY_GRPC_ENABLED=true AUTH_REQUIRED=false python -m mcpgateway.cli

# Terminal 2, register a service
curl -X 'POST'   'http://localhost:4444/admin/grpc'   -H 'accept: application/json'   -H 'Content-Type: application/json'   -d '{
  "name": "caikit.runtime.SampleLib.SampleLibService",
  "target": "localhost:8989",
  "description": "string",
  "reflection_enabled": true,
  "tls_enabled": false,
  "visibility": "public"
}'
```

commits.message:
fix: align gRPC metadata keys with MetadataCapture API

The grpc_service.py was reading metadata with short keys ("ip", "via",
"user_agent") that don't match what MetadataCapture returns
("created_from_ip", "created_via", "created_user_agent"). This caused
all audit metadata to silently resolve to None.

- Fix register_service to read "created_*" prefixed keys
- Fix update_service to read "modified_*" prefixed keys
- Use extract_modification_metadata for the update endpoint
- Update tests to use correct MetadataCapture method names and keys

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti
